_comment: Sowcast preset locations (the globe's accordion menu). Each 'location' is a point on farmland, checked against MODIS land cover (class 12 = cropland). The regions' town centres were deliberately NOT used: satellite crop and soil data there describes rooftops.

sites.name: Story County
sites.note: Corn & soybean farmland ~9 km NE of Ames.

sites.name: Ludhiana District
sites.note: Rice-wheat farmland SW of Ludhiana city.

sites.name: Nakuru County
sites.note: Highland maize farmland near Rongai. Equatorial: two rainy seasons (Mar-May, Oct-Dec).

sites.name: Darling Downs
sites.note: Dryland grain farmland west of Toowoomba.
